name: dsa_sparse_mla_fp8_h64_ckv512_kpe64_topk2048_ps64
description: GLM-5.2 DSA sparse MLA attention per rank (64 heads, attn_tp 1) as run on the decode leg for TARGET_VERIFY and DRAFT_EXTEND_V2 (speculative_attention_mode=prefill -> dsa_prefill_backend=triton: _sparse_mla_split_k_kernel + _sparse_mla_reduce_kernel, KV_SPLITS 2, fp8 dot). q is fp8 (written by fused_qk_rope_cat_and_cache_mla). sm_scale = (192 + 64) ** -0.5; the kernel folds log2(e) in (qk_scale 0.0902). num_tokens = 6 x bs_graph.

num_tokens.description: Query tokens on this rank (6 per request).

num_pages.description: Pages in the per-rank KV pool.

sparse_indices.description: Global token slots from the indexer.

reference:
import torch


@torch.no_grad()
def run(q_nope, q_rope, kv_cache, sparse_indices, sm_scale):
    """Sparse MLA over an fp8 latent KV cache (k_scale = v_scale = 1.0 in the deployment).
    kv_cache[p, o, :512] = latent ckv (also V), [512:576] = rope key. sparse_indices are global
    token slots (page * 64 + offset), -1 = padding."""
    T, H, D = q_nope.shape
    kv = kv_cache.reshape(-1, kv_cache.shape[-1]).float()
    invalid = sparse_indices < 0
    idx = sparse_indices.clamp_min(0).long()
    K = kv[idx]                                   # [T, topk, 576]
    q = torch.cat([q_nope.float(), q_rope.float()], dim=-1)   # [T, H, 576]
    logits = torch.einsum("thd,tkd->thk", q, K) * sm_scale
    logits = logits.masked_fill(invalid.unsqueeze(1), float("-inf"))
    p = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
    out = torch.einsum("thk,tkd->thd", p, K[..., :512])
    return out.to(torch.bfloat16)
